summary: Tested product photo upload (object storage), public photo endpoint, public QR menu (photo + description, zoom, 390px mobile), edit-modal description, and the iteration-22 overhead follow-ups. Backend: 15/15 new tests pass (1 skipped: no live invoice file in DB, so a fresh-invoice test was added and passes), and the iteration-22 regression (8) passes. Frontend: every flow I tested works. Real admin UI on product 'adana': add photo shrinks a 2000x1500 PNG to a 1200x900 JPEG; a bad file shows an error toast; Değiştir replaces the photo; Sil removes it; editing the description keeps the photo; /menu shows the thumbnail, opens the zoom overlay and closes it; with no photo the menu falls back to the plain layout; no horizontal scroll at 390px. Follow-ups checked: cost-suggested shows '—' with the note when ratio is 40% and target is 65%; manual cost shows '₺100,00 elle'; at 90% overhead adana is counted in 'Sabit giderle zarar eden: 1 ürün' and 'En düşük net marj: adana · %-8,9'; overhead inputs use dark text rgb(30,41,59) on white. The UI check of calc-suggested-note was not possible because the cost calculator has no inventory items to pick (the dropdown is empty); I only verified it by reading the code.

minor.issue: Deleting a product does not mark its photo file is_deleted, so /api/public/photos/{id} still serves the image publicly after the product is gone
If get_object fails in storage (missing object), the error is not handled and the endpoint returns 500 instead of 404

issues: The SuggestedPrice box still shows the material-only price ('Önerilen fiyat ₺286 · %65 marj'), while Ürün Maliyeti shows '—' because target + overhead is at least 100%. The two pages contradict each other
Negative percent is rendered as '%-8,9'; Turkish convention would be '-%8,9'
Transparent PNGs are converted to JPEG with no background fill, so transparent areas turn black. Fill the canvas with white before drawImage

action_items: Optional: when a product is deleted, mark its photo file is_deleted
Optional: wrap get_object in public_photo in try/except and return 404
Optional: make the product-card SuggestedPrice overhead-aware, or label it 'malzeme' so it matches Ürün Maliyeti
Optional: fill the canvas with white in shrink() for transparent PNGs
critical_code_review_comments: public_photo has no error handling around get_object (a missing object returns 500)
The product delete path does not clean up the photo record
upload_product_photo validates by file extension only, not by content (acceptable because only admins can upload)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the flows tested (calculator note checked by code review only)
